body.rationale: The rendered RTL dark-theme scene uses section, header, h2, div, and p elements, and its central control is a textarea component; none of those elements or a textarea control exists in the closed descriptor vocabulary, so the localized label and help relationships, counter, and component boundary cannot be represented without the lane markup.

content.blurb: Four text areas carry an overlong label, a grouped large number, escaped angle brackets and an ampersand, and a diacritic-rich name with an em dash.

body.react: <><TextArea aria-label="Long content" defaultValue="Awaiting third-party structural certification review" rows={2} /><TextArea aria-label="Large number" defaultValue="1,284,905" rows={2} /><TextArea aria-label="Escaped content" defaultValue={'Bay 4 <grid C-7> & 8'} rows={2} /><TextArea aria-label="Unusual name" defaultValue="Ordnance Survey — Niño Ångström" rows={2} /></>
body.blazor: <HarborlineTextArea aria-label="Long content" DefaultValue="Awaiting third-party structural certification review" Rows="2" /><HarborlineTextArea aria-label="Large number" DefaultValue="1,284,905" Rows="2" /><HarborlineTextArea aria-label="Escaped content" DefaultValue="@("Bay 4 <grid C-7> & 8")" Rows="2" /><HarborlineTextArea aria-label="Unusual name" DefaultValue="Ordnance Survey — Niño Ångström" Rows="2" />
body.rationale: The closed control vocabulary has no text-area control and cannot preserve four multiline values carrying hostile-but-valid content across both projection lanes.

content.blurb: The text area renders its declared invalid state with an accessible name.
